categories_thin: Land surveyors: no surveying firm with an Old Bridge Township office was found; the surveyors returned (Matawan, Metuchen, Piscataway, Sayreville, New Brunswick) are outside the zone.
Title agencies: four found; several Old Bridge closings are handled by East Brunswick or Sayreville title agencies, so local supply looks genuinely small.
Architecture: four local practices; most Old Bridge architects are solo/home-based and barely represented in directories.
Engineering: only R3M and CSA Central appear in association directories; larger Old Bridge projects use East Brunswick/Edison firms.
Property management: only two Old Bridge-based firms surfaced (Renaissance, Princeton PM); HOA/condo management in town is often handled from Woodbridge or East Brunswick offices.
caveats: Excluded as brand/franchise locations: Weichert Realtors (1394 US-9), RE/MAX Innovation (3877 CR-516), ERA Designs For Living, State Farm offices (Jerry Weinfeld, John Pepe Jr.), Farmers (Jonida Lagji), H&R Block, Edward Jones, Ameriprise, and the MRI Network office at 41 York St (franchise network).

Excluded as outside the zone: Pinnacle Accounting (8 Old Bridge Tpke is South River per Bing), Anchor Staffing, Raritan Agency, Sai CPA, Matthews & Nulty, JP CPA, Michael S. Green Law, Theodore Sliwinski (45 River Rd, East Brunswick), Edward Testino, Pickus & Aronson, Levine Furman & Rubin, Alguram Law Group, Criterion/Shepherd/New Dawn Title, Mega Title, Vintage Title, Tectonic Engineering, and Volk Insurance's Milltown office.
Entries sourcing only from NJ Business Directory, city-data business entities or D&B are registered-entity style records - they may not be staffed offices; each is flagged in active_evidence.

Bing/Google listings occasionally print the postal city (Matawan, Parlin, South River) for an address that is administratively in Old Bridge Township; town was assigned from the street address and cross-checked where possible.
Laurence Harbor businesses within roughly 10 miles of Milltown were treated as in-zone, but no professional-services firms were found there in this pass.
No logins, forms or account creation used; no outreach.
data_gaps: BBB category pages for Old Bridge returned a Cloudflare 'Just a moment' challenge, so BBB-accredited-only firms may be missing.
Yellow Pages, Manta, ChamberOfCommerce.com, Cylex and ACEC member-detail pages returned HTTP 403 to direct fetches; their content was used only as seen in search results.
Overpass API (OpenStreetMap) returned HTTP 406 / timed out, so no OSM pass was completed.
Google Maps only served a reduced five-result list per query, capping per-query coverage; many extra queries were run to compensate.

Entries still missing an address and/or phone: CSA Central, Skyline Environmental, ACCOUNTWORX, BBG Accounting, Gary Mehta CPA, Kevin Begley, AOK Appraising, Seal Appraisal (street number), Shah Consulting, Sun Insurance, Flipside Media, 3W Development, Design LOGIX, On Design Graphics, Monaco Advisory, Intertrade Consultants, Top Choice Title (phone), Bravo Title (phone), Custom Websites (phone listing only), Paggap/Masis (phone listing only).
No usable state licensing roster by municipality for CPAs or insurance producers was found, so accounting/insurance coverage relies on directories, carrier agent locators and map listings.
